campaign_1_to_2.note: campaign 2 minus campaign 1. A and B prompts are byte-identical between campaigns, so their deltas measure run-to-run noise plus scorer/normaliser differences (different sessions scored each campaign). n=5 per arm; no significance test. The hidden-sector credit rule also differs: campaign 1 did not credit three A records it later tested as a sensitivity, while campaign 2 credits labels naming the hidden/dark sector, merged SIDM units included; Delta A and Delta B on coverage and hidden-sector carry that rule change. C's gain survives the strict rule (no merged unit credited: C coverage 0.96, hidden-sector 4/5).
